methodology.clock: Prepared drawing request submitted to OpenAI, through complete validation and two animation frames in real Chromium. No speech, STT, intent, retrieval or scene routing is included.
methodology.format: All representations are rendered in an 800×500 SVG comparison frame. Current production diagrams already use SVG; production matrices are HTML+KaTeX. The benchmark normalizes rendering surfaces and compares generation syntax plus each format’s layout machinery.
methodology.sample: One initial sample per eligible scene/format, then two further samples per top-two general formats on three representative scenes. Initial selection is exploratory; individual failures and raw outputs are retained.
methodology.routing: All model-generated output waits for completion and validation. No unsafe partially streamed SVG is displayed.
methodology.sources: Identical explicit source facts and public request within each scene. Synthetic facts are labeled. No answer keys or expected output are sent.
methodology.mermaid: Only tree, function plot, and process cases: flowchart layout/xychart are appropriate; exact matrix-cell selection and coordinate-preserving city edits are outside this restricted Mermaid contract.
methodology.scope: Benchmark-only scripts, SVGs and local viewer. No production UI/provider changes, no paid voice, no external deployment.

notes: Original automatic checks are retained in initialChecks. Final checks add actual browser coordinate/label overlap tests.
Cell counts require a complete unique 8×10 rectangle grid; blank values are checked against actual text inside cell regions.
City vendors must lie on the same line and match normalized positions, and a patch must preserve the prior line and B geometry.
Edge attachment and function geometry still receive visual/manual inspection. These checks do not prove full semantic correctness.

manualInspection.scope: All initial and cross-subject outputs received recorded screenshot review. Repeated outputs received structural/content/geometry checks, with additional specific manual findings. Recorded notes are targeted findings, not exhaustive visual certification.

process-dsl-1.note: The renderer draws opaque stage boxes over the arrow tips, so directed connections appear as plain lines. This is a renderer layout limitation, not a source-fact change.

process-json-1.note: Stage boxes and arrows occupy four separate diagram surfaces; connectors do not join their intended boxes.

line-city-json-1.note: A, B, and the city line occupy separate diagram surfaces. The labels are present but the shared geometry is incorrect.

patch-city-json-1.note: The patch preserves the original disconnected city layout; stable IDs alone do not make this a correct scene.

payoff-matrix-dsl-1.note: All four tuples are in the correct rows and columns. Generic lines/text have no semantic matrix object or full-cell hit regions.

function-plot-dsl-1.note: Correct five samples, but model-authored y label overlaps the renderer-owned title; x label is duplicated.

function-plot-json-1.note: Five source samples are correct. Coordinate labels intersect point markers/axes and need clearer placement.
